title: ADscan run coverage v1
description: coverage.json: which checks a run performed, on which domain and scope, and how completely. It is the projection of the observation record that decides what a run may close: only a check that ran completely on a scope can resolve a finding there. A check absent from this document was not assessed by the run, which is never the same as clear. May name AD objects in examined_ids, so it stays on the node unless the data policy allows findings. Written by adscan_core/engagement/coverage_io.py (run_coverage_to_document); the tag in schema is the constant COVERAGE_SCHEMA.

incomplete_phases.$comment: Every scan phase that started but did not finish; empty when none.
